##: Inno Setup 6.7.4 installer (packaging/LampGuide.iss, PrivilegesRequired=lowest, per-user DefaultDirName={localappdata}\Programs\Lamp Guide). Upstream ships only the setup exe (no portable zip), so this package runs the official installer silently into the scoop dir without elevation. The installer bundles and auto-installs the Microsoft WebView2 Evergreen x64 runtime only when it is missing, and preserves an existing Run-key startup preference (never creates one from scratch). Removal delegates to the installer's own unins000.exe.
description: Lamp Guide —— zen-gate 的 Windows 桌面重构版：统一管理模型与渠道、聚合轮换、Agent 接入，内置本地 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容网关与日夜主题
notes: 上游只发 Inno Setup 安装器（约 211MB），没有便携版：本包用 /VERYSILENT + /DIR 把它静默装进 Scoop 目录（按用户安装、PrivilegesRequired=lowest，正常不弹 UAC）
安装器自带微软官方 WebView2 离线运行环境，仅在系统缺少 WebView2 时自动安装（极少数缺失场景可能触发一次 UAC）
网关数据目录沿用 zen-gate（旧版账号/渠道/模型聚合/日夜设置可平滑迁移），用户数据不写入安装目录，卸载保留账号与配置
本包不自建开机启动项；安装器只在已存在 Lamp Guide / Zen Gate 启动项时改写其指向
卸载走安装器自带的 unins000.exe
